expectations.text: Requires a full CLEAN_SIM.md cycle before testing, even though the sim is described as already running
expectations.evidence: It offers the clean cycle only as one of three options the user picks between - "(a) run the read-only precondition checks below against the sim you have up and proceed only if it is at that pose, (b) do the full clean restart cycle first" - and its Step 0 through Step 5 plan is written to run against the live sim. It never requires the cycle.

expectations.text: Names the concrete clean gate values (opt/ros : 0 and shm : 0) as a precondition to launching
expectations.evidence: Neither 'opt/ros' nor 'shm' appears anywhere in the response; CLEAN_SIM.md is referred to only by name, with no gate values.

expectations.evidence: "This exact test already exists as a written procedure: DEMO.md -> 'Demo: local costmap avoids an unmapped box (park)' (Steps 1-6)... I would follow it verbatim rather than improvise a box spawn", reusing (14, -0.66) and (27.12, 1.10).

expectations.text: Does not treat 'the sim is already up' as permission to skip straight to the test
expectations.evidence: "So my first action is to ask, not to run" - it raises two blockers (unknown start pose, unknown launch config) and refuses to spawn the box before the user answers.
